description: Declarative coverage/rule registry for the bounded marine-technical entailment contract. Every controlled enum token in the fixed v0.6 field inventory (plus the preserved legacy v0.5 rig_type/rudder_type vocabularies) is classified as exactly one of DEFINITIONAL_ENTAILMENT, DIRECT_ONLY or NO_DERIVATION. This is a closed, hand-maintained coverage table, not a generic rule engine: adding a new schema enum token without adding its classification here is a coverage failure, by design.

reverse_relations.reason: A concrete hull_count does not uniquely identify a named topology: an allowed 'other' topology (e.g. a proa-like asymmetric configuration) can share the same hull_count as monohull/catamaran/trimaran. Reverse of MTE-HULL-001..003 is unsafe and is not authorized.

appendages.keel_type.notes: No non-board keel_type token (full/modified_full/long_fin/fin/wing/bulb/twin/bilge/swing/lifting/shoal) entails centerboard_count=0 or daggerboard_count=0: keel-centerboard and other hybrid appendage combinations exist, and absence is not negative evidence.

appendages.keel_subtype.reason: Arbitrary string; no closed vocabulary exists to bind an entailment to.

appendages.centerboard_type.reason: Arbitrary string; no closed vocabulary exists to bind an entailment to.

appendages.daggerboard_type.reason: Arbitrary string; no closed vocabulary exists to bind an entailment to.

appendages.rudder_position.notes: rudder_position never entails rudder_support in v0.6-native data: a transom-positioned rudder can independently carry keel/skeg support semantics (see BOAT_DESIGN_V05_TO_V06_MAPPING.md section 3.2 and fixtures/technical_profile/valid/01_classic_aft_cockpit_masthead_sloop.json).

appendages.rudder_support.notes: rudder_support never entails rudder_position (independent axes) and never entails keel_type/skeg_type concretely beyond the skeg-presence exclusion in MTE-RUD-002.

appendages.skeg_type.notes: skeg_type=full and skeg_type=partial do not entail rudder_support=skeg: a skeg-equipped hull can still carry a rudder the skeg does not structurally support.

rig.sailplan.notes: sailplan never entails masthead_fractional in v0.6-native data, including sailplan=cat: an unstayed cat rig is a plausible basis for masthead_fractional=not_applicable, but that basis is a maritime-exception judgment call outside the v0.6 token itself, so it is deliberately NOT asserted here (see MARINE_TECHNICAL_ENTAILMENT.v0.1.md section 6).

rig.masthead_fractional.notes: masthead_fractional never entails sailplan or mast_count: masthead/fractional character is not uniquely restricted to one sailplan family.

reverse_relations.reason: mast_count=1 does not uniquely identify sloop/cutter/cat; mast_count=2 does not uniquely identify ketch/yawl/a two-masted schooner. Reverse of MTE-RIG-001..006 is unsafe and is not authorized.

rig.rig_variant.reason: Arbitrary string; no closed vocabulary exists to bind an entailment to.

deck.helm_type.notes: helm_type never entails helm_count: a wheel or tiller helm does not definitionally guarantee a specific helm station count (twin-wheel installations exist).

legacy.rig_type.notes: Preserves the accepted SLICE-0034 compatibility mapping (BOAT_DESIGN_V05_TO_V06_MAPPING.md section 3.1) verbatim. The 'other'/'unknown' rows are trivial word-identity projections (sailplan takes the same opaque word) carrying no new information; they are still recorded as DEFINITIONAL_ENTAILMENT for registry consistency with the already-accepted table, not because they yield a substantive new fact.

legacy.rudder_type.notes: Preserves the accepted SLICE-0034 compatibility mapping (BOAT_DESIGN_V05_TO_V06_MAPPING.md section 3.2, amendments 1 and 2) verbatim, including the rudder_balance-is-always-unknown finding and the twin/rudder_count conflict rule.

rules.prerequisites: hull_configuration is a qualified, accepted (non-provisional, non-conflicted) value of exactly 'monohull'.
rules.applicability: Applies within the single resolved BoatDesign baseline or NamedVariant/DesignOption override scope where hull_configuration is itself qualified as monohull; does not import hull_configuration from a different scope.
rules.exceptions: None: a monohull has exactly one hull by definition.
rules.conflict_behavior: If the same scope already carries a qualified explicit hull_count other than 1, surface UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT per TECHNICAL_PROFILE_SPEC.v0.1.md sections 5-6; do not silently overwrite either value. (Also independently enforced structurally by BOAT_DESIGN_SCHEMA.v0.6.json's hull_configuration/hull_count if/then invariant when both fields are concretely present.)
rules.evidence_basis: Dictionary/definitional meaning of 'monohull' (single-hulled vessel); already-accepted v0.6 schema invariant.
rules.lineage_requirement: Derived hull_count must record rule_id MTE-HULL-001, version 0.1, the qualifying hull_configuration=monohull fact and its applicability scope, distinguishable from a directly reported hull_count.

rules.evidence_basis: Dictionary/definitional meaning of 'catamaran' (twin-hulled vessel); already-accepted v0.6 schema invariant.
rules.lineage_requirement: Derived hull_count must record rule_id MTE-HULL-002, version 0.1, the qualifying fact and applicability scope.

rules.prerequisites: keel_type is a qualified, accepted value of exactly 'centerboard' (i.e. the boat's primary keel-equivalent appendage is itself a centerboard).
rules.applicability: Applies within the single resolved BoatDesign baseline or NamedVariant/DesignOption override scope where keel_type is itself qualified.
rules.exceptions: The exact count is not guaranteed (single or twin centerboards both exist); only presence of at least one is definitionally guaranteed.
rules.conflict_behavior: If the same scope already carries a qualified explicit centerboard_count of 0, surface UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT; do not silently overwrite either value.
rules.evidence_basis: Dictionary/definitional meaning: keel_type='centerboard' asserts the primary appendage IS a centerboard, so at least one must exist.
rules.lineage_requirement: A derived centerboard_count>=1 fact must record rule_id MTE-KEEL-001, version 0.1, the qualifying keel_type fact and applicability scope; it must not be upgraded to an exact count without separate qualified evidence.

rules.exceptions: rudder_position and rudder_balance are explicitly NOT entailed (must project 'unknown'). 'partial' qualifies the skeg's physical extent, not the rudder's position or balance; skeg_type is a separate straight-moved field and is not set to 'partial' by this rule.
rules.conflict_behavior: If the same v0.5 record already carries a contradicting explicit v0.6-shaped rudder_support value, surface UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT; do not silently overwrite either value.
rules.evidence_basis: BOAT_DESIGN_V05_TO_V06_MAPPING.md section 3.2 (accepted SLICE-0034 mapping, amendment-1 corrected).
rules.lineage_requirement: Record rule_id MTE-LEGACY-RUD-003, version 0.1, and the qualifying legacy rudder_type=partial_skeg fact.

rules.prerequisites: Legacy v0.5 rudder_type is qualified as exactly 'twin'; source rudder_count is jointly known (including the qualified null state).
rules.applicability: Applies to translating a single qualified v0.5 record's own baseline into v0.6-shaped facts; both rudder_type and rudder_count must come from the same record/scope.
rules.exceptions: rudder_position, rudder_support and rudder_balance are explicitly NOT entailed by 'twin' (must project 'unknown' for all three): 'twin' describes rudder count only.
rules.conflict_behavior: A source rudder_count concretely other than 2 (e.g. 0, 1, 3, 4) is an internally inconsistent v0.5 payload. This rule does not silently overwrite the recorded count with 2, and does not silently keep the recorded count while dropping the twin fact; it raises a flagged conflict for manual/conflict resolution per TECHNICAL_PROFILE_SPEC.v0.1.md sections 5-6, exactly mirroring the existing accepted RudderCountMappingConflict behavior.
rules.evidence_basis: BOAT_DESIGN_V05_TO_V06_MAPPING.md section 3.2 'rudder_count and twin' (accepted SLICE-0034 mapping, amendment 2): the word 'twin' definitionally IS the count fact, so a null/unrecorded source count must not discard it.
rules.lineage_requirement: Record rule_id MTE-LEGACY-RUD-006, version 0.1, the qualifying legacy rudder_type=twin fact, and the source rudder_count value actually observed (null/2/conflict).
